Southern Kafue - Zambia’s Wildest Kept Secret
Nanzhila Lake Camp and Nanzhila Plains Camp are two safari lodges located in the Kafue National Park offering unforgettable predator sightings & personalised hospitality.
Email us for Rates
Accommodation
Intimate Stays in the Kafue Wilderness
Nanzhila Safaris offers two distinct lodge experiences, each designed to showcase a different facet of the Southern Kafue's ecology. Both camps emphasize "bush luxury"-sustainable, comfortable, and deeply connected to the surrounding environment
Nanzhila Lake Camp
Nanzhila Plains Camp
Game Viewing
Guaranteed Predator Viewing across both camps
Known as the "Place of Predators," the Southern Kafue delivers a high-quality big cat experience that rivals any in Zambia. Across both Nanzhila Plains Camp and Nanzhila Lake Camp , guests enjoy consistent and exclusive sightings of lion, leopard, cheetah, and the endangered African wild dog.
Nanzhila Lake Camp
Nanzhila Plains Camp
Wildlife Variety
Wide variety of wildlife and bird species
The key word about Southern Kafue is diversity - you will not find another wildlife region in Zambia with as wide a variety of mammal and bird species as Southern Kafue. Currently, the 24 hour mammal species count record at Plains Camp is 27 different mammal species across 2 game drives
Wildlife species in the Kafue
Inter-camp packages
Choose between our 6, 9 or 12 night safari packages
Experience the best of Zambia with our curated safari packages, including the popular "Stay 6, Pay 5" Plains and Lake Combo . For a complete adventure, our Wildlife & Waterfalls itinerary seamlessly links the Kafue National Park with Victoria Falls. From 9-night park-wide circuits to seasonal Green Season specials, our packages offer exceptional value for those seeking an intimate, long-stay encounter with Africa's diverse wildlife .
View available packages
The Experience
Authentic, personalised hospitality
When you arrive at Nanzhila, you are not just arriving at "another" lodge. You are being welcomed into someone's home! So expect a heartfelt welcome, delicious food, personalized camp touches and years worth of stories from the bush.

Safari Accommodation | Nanzhila Plains & Lake Camp | Kafue
Skip to content
Kafue Lodge Accommodation
Nanzhila Safaris' two intimate bushcamps, Lake Camp and Plains Camp, offer remote wilderness, warm Zambian hospitality, and consistent predator sightings in Southern Kafue.
Plains Camp — Open Grassland, Big Cat Country
Plains Camp sits in the quietest part of Southern Kafue, where open grassland and a game-rich dambo bring wildlife close — sometimes right up to your chalet door. What guests love about Plains Camp:
A wide variety of wildlife and bird species, with some of the Kafue's most consistent predator sightings
Warm, personalised hospitality from a team who know the area intimately
Miles of genuinely remote wilderness, with almost no other vehicles or guests around
The occasional wildlife "visitor" wandering past camp after dark
Plains Camp
Lake Camp — Shoreline Wildlife, Water's Edge Living
Lake Camp looks out over a landscape in constant motion — elephant, buffalo, and hippo moving along the shoreline, with some of Zambia's highest predator densities gathering seasonally just beyond camp.
What guests love about Lake Camp:
The constant flow of wildlife passing directly in front of camp
Warm hospitality paired with years of bush knowledge and storytelling from the guiding team
Occasional boating and fishing on the lake, water levels permitting
Lake Camp

About Nanzhila Safaris
Find out who the people are behind the brand!
Nanzhila Safaris is the Kafue brand within the Everwild portfolio responsible for managing, marketing and operating Nanzhila Plains Camp and Nanzhila Lake Camp.
A proud member of th e Everwil d Portfolio
Everwild is a group of conservationists, biologists, and hospitality experts dedicated to "hosting by wilderness." By sitting within the Everwild family, Luangwa Valley Safaris benefits from a broader network of expertise and a shared commitment to five core pillars: Purpose, Position, Product, Profit, and People.
When you book a safari with us, you are supported by Everwild's group-wide dedication to remote hospitality and deep conservation impact, ensuring that your journey is not only life-changing for you but also sustainable for the wild places we call home.

Travel Directions & Logistics - Getting to the Kafue National Park
Skip to content
How to get to the Kafue National Park?
The Kafue is Zambia's largest National Park and so working out how to move around can be very intimidating! We are here to help you find the easiest and most straight forward means for reaching our camps!
01/ Where are we located?
Both Nanzhila Plains and Lake camp are situated in the Kafue National Park, Zambia.
Nanzhila Plains Camp is located in the southern section of Kafue National Park, Zambia and Nanzhila Lake Camp is located 3.5 hrs north of Plains Camp on the shores of Lake Itezhi-tezhi.
Camp Co-Ordinates:
Plains Camp:  -16.279055, 25.918035 | Lake Camp:  - 15.894529, 25.765131
ABOVE: Airlines which fly to Lusaka International Airport.
02/ Getting to Zambia
Option 1: Fly to Lusaka
To access the Kafue, you can either fly to LUSAKA International Airport or LIVINGSTONE International Airport.
As of 2025 these are the airlines which fly to Lusaka :
Airlink (4Z)
British Airways (BA)
Air Botswana (BP)
Emirates (EK)
Ethiopian Airlines (ET)
Kenya Airways (KQ)
EgyptAir (MS)
Proflight Zambia (P0)
Qatar Airways (QR)
Turkish Airlines (TK)
American Airlines (AA)
KLM (KL)
Air France (AF)
Iberia (IB)
Finnair (AY)
JetBlue Airways (B6)
Saudia (SV)
LATAM Airlines Group SA (LA)
Air India (AI)
Need help? We can help plan your trip!
ABOVE: Direct flights are available from Cape Town, Johannesburg or Nairobi
03/ Getting to Zambia
Option 2: Fly to Livingstone or Victoria Falls
Your 2nd option is to fly directly into LIVINGSTONE International Airport or Vic Falls Airport. As of 2025 these are the airlines which fly to Livingstone:
Kenya Airways (KQ) - From Nairobi
Proflight Zambia (P0) - From Cape Town
Airlink (4Z) - From Johannesburg
Zambia Airways (ZN) - From Lusaka
Need help? We can help plan your trip!
04/ Arrival in Zambia
We will collect you from the airport and drive you to camp.
Once your flights are booked, we will arrange all your logistics on the ground. Upon arrival at the airport, we will meet you and transfer you by road to the camp.
Driving distances are as follows:
Livingstone - Lake Camp and or / Plains Camp: 5 -6 hours
Lusaka - Lake Camp and or / Plains Camp: 5 -6 hours
Prefer to charter into the Kafue? There is an airstrip 45min from Lake Camp.
Chat to us about options.
05/ Optional Trip Add-ons
Want to add a stopover before or after your visit to the Kafue?
If you would like to add a night or two in Victoria Falls or Lusaka before or after your time in Nanzhila, chat to us!
Need help? We can help plan your trip!
